environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2), running as ec2-user with standard shell access. Flask app behind an nginx reverse proxy with default configuration (proxy_pass to localhost:8080). No request body inspection. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. ImageMagick 6.9.x and exiftool installed via yum. Process runs under systemd with default unit file (no sandboxing directives).

config.proxy: nginx 1.20 default proxy_pass, no ModSecurity, no body filtering
config.systemd_unit: Type=simple, no ProtectSystem, no SystemCallFilter, no PrivateTmp
